claims.claimText: Students must score above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in their relevant Class XII board examination stream.
claims.supportingPassage: Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the particular Board of Examination in Class XII.

claims.claimText: Annual gross family income ceiling is Rs. 4.5 Lakh per annum; certificate required only once during fresh application.
claims.supportingPassage: Gross parental/family income ceiling is Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum. Income certificate required from fresh applicants only once.

claims.claimText: Renewal requires a minimum of 50% marks in the annual examination and at least 75% attendance.
claims.supportingPassage: Renewal criteria: Student must secure at least 50% marks in the annual examination and minimum 75% attendance.

claims.claimText: One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory on the National Scholarship Portal, and disbursement is strictly via Aadhaar-linked DBT.
claims.supportingPassage: One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory on NSP from AY 2024-25. Beneficiaries must possess Aadhaar-linked bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

gaps.title: Official 2026–27 State Board Cut-off Percentile Marks Circular
gaps.description: Potential Information Gap — Not found in the sources reviewed.
gaps.whyItMatters: While the guideline specifies the 80th percentile threshold, the exact mark cut-off list for state boards for Academic Year 2026–27 is not published in reviewed documents.
gaps.whatWasNotFound: Specific raw mark cut-offs published by individual State Education Boards for 2026.
gaps.suggestedSourceToVerify: Respective State Education Board announcements and NSP Merit List Gazette.
gaps.recommendedAction: Request official cut-off list from State Board of Higher Secondary Education before applying.

gaps.title: Authorized Income Certificate Issuing Authority Specification
gaps.description: Potential Information Gap — Not found in the sources reviewed.
gaps.whyItMatters: Different states authorize different revenue officers (e.g., Tahsildar, Revenue Inspector, Sub-Divisional Magistrate); reviewed guidelines state the ceiling but not the acceptable officer ranks.
gaps.whatWasFound: Gross income ceiling of Rs. 4.5 Lakh per annum.
gaps.whatWasNotFound: Exact list of legally recognized certificate issuing authorities across states.
gaps.suggestedSourceToVerify: State Nodal Officer guidelines and District Revenue Department guidelines.
gaps.recommendedAction: Confirm with college verification officer whether Tahsildar-level digital certificate is accepted.

gaps.title: Defective Application Correction Protocol & Re-submission Window
gaps.description: Potential Information Gap — Not found in the sources reviewed.
gaps.whyItMatters: Portal specifies defective verification closing on 15-12-2026, but the exact student re-submission turn-around timeline is not detailed.
gaps.whatWasNotFound: Maximum days allowed for student to re-upload corrected documents after rejection.
gaps.recommendedAction: Verify institute verification schedule to ensure prompt remediation if marked defective.

conflicts.aspect: PM-USP CSSS Application & Renewal Closing Deadlines
conflicts.label: POTENTIAL DEADLINE DISCREPANCY — REQUIRES OFFICIAL CONFIRMATION
conflicts.explanation: The National Scholarship Portal's Scheme Listing (All-Scholarships) indicates that Student Applications for Renewal are open until 30 November 2026, whereas the general Students Announcement notice desk states a closing date of 31 October 2026. This creates a critical risk that applicants relying on the 30 November date could find the portal closed if the 31 October announcement is enforced.

freshnessWarnings.warningReason: Document was promulgated on 07 February 2024 for the 2022-23 through 2024 cycle. While foundational criteria (80th percentile, 50% marks) remain active, operational circulars for 2026–27 must be cross-checked for any amendments in income slabs or course categorizations.
freshnessWarnings.affectedInformation: Active application cycle quotas and financial caps.
freshnessWarnings.suggestedAction: Cross-check against Department of Higher Education 2026 notices.

freshnessWarnings.sourceTitle: Historical MHRD Guidelines of CSSS for College and University Students
freshnessWarnings.warningReason: Historical document returned HTTP 404 (Not Found). Historical references citing older Rs. 10,000/year rates or earlier income limits are superseded by the current Rs. 12,000 / Rs. 20,000 guidelines.
freshnessWarnings.affectedInformation: Superseded legacy scholarship rates and previous income ceilings.
freshnessWarnings.suggestedAction: Rely exclusively on updated 2024-2026 Department of Higher Education documentation.

unansweredQuestions.question: Which deadline governs PM-USP CSSS Renewal: 31 October 2026 or 30 November 2026?
unansweredQuestions.whyItMatters: Students face immediate disqualification if they rely on the later directory date and the portal closes on 31 October.
unansweredQuestions.relatedInformationFound: All-Scholarships states 30-11-2026; Student Notice Desk states 31-10-2026.
relatedSourceTitles: National Scholarship Portal — Student Announcement Notice Desk
unansweredQuestions.suggestedVerificationStep: Submit an urgent inquiry to NSP Helpdesk and submit prior to 31 October.

unansweredQuestions.question: Has the Department of Higher Education notified the official Class XII Board-wise 80th percentile cut-off marks for 2026–27?
unansweredQuestions.whyItMatters: Percentile raw cut-off scores vary per board and stream (Science, Commerce, Humanities).
unansweredQuestions.relatedInformationFound: Guidelines mention 80th percentile rule, but no cutoff table is embedded.
unansweredQuestions.suggestedVerificationStep: Check respective State Education Board portal for 2026 scholarship cutoff marks.

unansweredQuestions.question: Is biometric authentication mandatory in addition to One Time Registration (OTR) for institute verification?
unansweredQuestions.whyItMatters: Biometric authentication delays at the college level can prevent institute verification before deadline.
unansweredQuestions.relatedInformationFound: OTR is mandatory per FAQ document; Aadhaar-linked DBT is mandatory.
relatedSourceTitles: PM-USP CSSS Official Frequently Asked Questions
unansweredQuestions.suggestedVerificationStep: Consult college nodal verification officer for biometric kiosk requirements.
